tasks.title: Add kilometers_to_miles
tasks.description: convert kilometers to miles, following the same one-line conversion pattern as the functions above
tasks.pattern_example:
def celsius_to_fahrenheit(celsius: float) -> float:
    return celsius * 9 / 5 + 32
tasks.exact_code:
def kilometers_to_miles(km: float) -> float:
    return km * 0.621371

tasks.title: Add miles_to_kilometers
tasks.description: convert miles to kilometers, the inverse of kilometers_to_miles, following the same one-line conversion pattern
tasks.exact_code:
def miles_to_kilometers(miles: float) -> float:
    return miles / 0.621371
